name: Vulcan's Hoard
purpose: The user's personal library of 3D-printable models: folders of STL, 3MF and OBJ files scanned locally (dimensions, triangles, watertightness, thumbnails, duplicates) so the assistant can find models and write their marketplace listings.
notes: Keep the app running (python -m vulcan) while the assistant uses it: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server and never opens the database. Scanning a big folder takes a while the first time (metrics plus one CPU-rendered thumbnail per file); later scans only read what changed.
